name: NGC 1381 (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 1381, an edge-on lenticular galaxy in the Fornax Cluster, seen by Hubble.
label: ngc1381-hubble
story: We see this lenticular galaxy edge-on, its disk a thin blade of starlight in the crowded heart of the Fornax Cluster. Studies of its motions find a fast-rotating thin disk wrapped in a slower, thicker one.

claims.text: FCC 170 is NGC 1381, an S0 galaxy in the Fornax cluster
It lies in the densest region of the Fornax cluster
It has a fast-rotating thin disk and a slower rotating thick disk
FCC 170 = NGC1381, type S0, imaged in the ACS Fornax Cluster Survey (GO 10217)
